$comment: GLOBAL harness configuration for the multi-project Agent Harness.
PATHS ARE RELATIVE TO THIS DIRECTORY on purpose. In the maintainer instance they are absolute,
which is exactly what stops a clone from working on another machine. lib/paths.js resolves every
relative value against the harness root, and an absolute value is still honoured as-is, so this
file is portable without any code above it knowing the difference.
ASCII-ONLY. On Windows, PowerShell Get-Content defaults to the system ANSI code page, so a
scripted Get-Content/Set-Content round-trip on UTF-8 source silently destroys non-ASCII
characters and the damage is lossy. Keeping tool source ASCII makes such a round-trip a no-op.

harness.name: agent-harness
harness.description: Multi-project Agent Harness: supervisor planning, worker dispatch, workspace and task registry. Bundled with EvidenceCrew.

$comment_worker: The ChatGPT Web Worker lives outside this harness and is treated as a protected resource. The
harness drives it through its public CLI surface and never edits it. One browser session and one
persistent profile are shared across projects because the ChatGPT login is global; isolation
between projects happens at the CONVERSATION level.

projectDefaults.$comment: Applied when a project PROJECT.yaml omits a field. A project may override any of these.

$comment: GLOBAL PERMANENT RULES, enforced in code rather than by convention. forbiddenRoots lists
directories a project may never be registered from: a project root is where the agents are
allowed to READ AND WRITE, so pointing one at a filesystem root would hand them the machine.
The maintainer instance also lists personal folders; they are absent here because paths differ
per machine and os.homedir() is checked at runtime as well.
